checkpoint_selection.aggregation: mean patch probability within each annotation-derived event instance, followed by multiclass NLL over the 11 validation events
scientific_rationale: Nine-class validation macro-F1 is structurally inappropriate because construction and running have no independent validation component in B1-R.
Observed-seven-class macro-F1 is discontinuous and highly unstable with only 11 validation events, including singleton classes.

Event-level NLL is a smooth proper probabilistic score defined for every validation event and uses the full 9-way softmax; probability assigned to absent classes is indirectly penalized on observed events.
The criterion still cannot directly validate construction/running accuracy; that limitation is explicit and no performance claim for those classes is made before final held-out test evaluation.

data_access_contract.phase2_shards: reuse frozen read-only HDF5 shards; no raw-signal re-extraction

allowed: bug fixes that preserve protocol semantics
forbidden_after_protocol_freeze: changing GRL schedule or location-loss weight
using test outcomes to alter training/checkpoint rules

event_inference.patch_to_event: arithmetic mean of patch class probabilities

initialization_equivalence.raw_pair: For each seed, raw TS-ResNet and raw SCAL-DAS must have identical initial backbone and event-head weights before the adversarial head is instantiated.
initialization_equivalence.spectral_pair: For each seed, Spectrum-RDFT and SCAL-RDFT must have identical initial backbone and event-head weights; the only additional random parameters are the SCAL location head.

predeclared_checkpoint_sensitivity.purpose: checkpoint-selection sensitivity only; never used to choose the headline model after seeing test results
predeclared_checkpoint_sensitivity.reporting_rule: If sensitivity is reported, all three checkpoint definitions must be shown for all four models and all three seeds; no cherry-picking.

training.reason_no_early_stopping: Validation contains only 7/9 classes; training horizon must not depend on a structurally incomplete class subset.
training.sampler_definition: uniform over classes, then uniform over train events within class, then uniform over patches within event

uncertainty.singleton_class_rule: Singleton test classes remain fixed within their class stratum in each bootstrap replicate; disclose this limitation.
